remarks: Imagine waking up to the gentle sounds of the Mianus River, where every day feels like a vacation in your own DIRECT WATERFRONT END UNIT CONDO! This freshly painted two-bedroom, two-bath sanctuary in the heart of Cos Cob is not just a home; it's a lifestyle waiting to be embraced. Featuring a galley kitchen that would make any chef swoon-with GRANITE countertops and top-of-the-line Stainless Steel appliances, including a Viking Range. The sun-drenched Dining Room is perfect for hosting everything from intimate dinners to lively celebrations, while the Living Room, adorned with a stunning wood-burning fireplace trimmed in marble, invites warmth and charm. Step onto your PRIVATE BALCONY and let the serene water views wash over you, providing the perfect backdrop for relaxation. The main bedroom offers versatility for guests or a home office, complete with a beautifully remodeled bath and an oversized step-in shower. Ascend to the dreamy Primary Bedroom, where VAULTED ceilings and a luxurious tiled bath with a deep soaking tub create an oasis of tranquility. This delightful pet-friendly complex has the convenience of an assigned covered garage parking spot, an additional outdoor spot, and your very own storage unit. This incredible location is just steps away from the VIBRANT Cos Cob Village, chic shops, delectable restaurants, train station, and the gorgeous Cos Cob Park. Added benefits of the HOA covering HEAT/hot water. Possible dock leases through the Marina. A RARE find.
